name: The Book of Tornaluna Cats
source:
You found Tanya in the crater — injured, confused, and without memories.
As you care for her — feeding her, healing her, reading together — something more begins to grow…
Her strength returns. Her memories return. And with them… so does your bond.

[From [url=https://panditastudio.itch.io/the-book-of-tornaluna-cats-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在火山口中找到了坦尼娅——她受伤了、困惑且失去了记忆。
当你关心她时——喂养她、治愈她、一起读书——更多的东西开始生长……
她的力量恢复了。她的记忆恢复了。和他们的关系……你们的关系也是如此。

[来自[url=https://panditastudio.itch.io/the-book-of-tornaluna-cats-demo]itch.io[/url]]
